recent_notes.task_title: Fix flaky ralph session-budget-integration timeout test
recent_notes.author: @claude
recent_notes.content: Root cause: spawnRalphUntil and testSignalCleanup helpers used cwd: process.cwd() (real project root). When the real working tree had uncommitted changes, getWorkingTreeStatus() returned dirty, causing runWrapUpAgent() to spawn a wrap-up agent with a 2-minute timeout — well exceeding the test's 25s safety timeout. Fix: (1) Changed cwd to tempDir (in /tmp, outside any git repo), (2) Initialize a clean git repo in tempDir with initial commit so getWorkingTreeStatus() reliably returns clean, (3) This ensures isWrapUpNeeded() returns false and wrap-up is skipped. All 3513 tests pass.

recent_notes.task_title: Review skills should always dig for task/spec context, never skip AC checks
recent_notes.author: @claude
recent_notes.content: Updated 4 skill files with dig-deeper spec context discovery pattern. Changes: (1) codex SKILL.md line 128 — replaced 'skip AC checks' with 5-step discovery process (commit trailers, task search, AC annotations, then validate if found). Also added discovery instruction to the simpler review subcommand prompt. (2) pr-review SKILL.md — removed hard error gate for missing task ref, replaced with discovery pattern that checks PR body, commit messages, diff annotations, and task list search. Now accepts PR numbers directly. (3) local-review SKILL.md — added Step 0: Discover Spec Context before the existing 8 steps. Falls back to code-quality-only review if no spec found. (4) templates/skills/review/SKILL.md — added Spec Context Discovery section as the base building block that all review skills reference. All 3513 tests pass (1 known flaky ralph timeout unrelated).

recent_notes.task_title: Review skills should always dig for task/spec context, never skip AC checks
recent_notes.author: @claude

recent_notes.task_title: Review skills should always dig for task/spec context, never skip AC checks
recent_notes.author: @claude
recent_notes.content:
## Problem

Codex PR review said 'No PR Task trailer was present, so spec/trait AC coverage checks were skipped per instructions' on PR #510. This defeats the purpose of spec-first development — reviewers should always validate against specs.

## Affected Skills

### 1. .claude/skills/codex/SKILL.md (line 128)
Current: 'If no Task trailer exists, proceed with pure code review (skip AC checks).'
Fix: Replace with instructions to dig deeper — check commit trailers, search tasks list, check AC annotations in changed files, then validate against found specs. Only fall back to pure code review if genuinely no spec coverage exists for the change.

### 2. .claude/skills/pr-review/SKILL.md
Current: Requires task ref as a hard validation gate ('Task reference required. Error immediately.')
Fix: Instead of erroring, dig for context the same way — commit trailers, task list search, AC annotations. The PR body trailer is a convenience, not a prerequisite.

### 3. .claude/skills/local-review/SKILL.md
Current: AC coverage checks are unconditional (good), but only when spec context is already known.
Fix: Add step to discover spec context if not explicitly provided — same dig-deeper pattern.

## Dig-Deeper Pattern (apply to all three)

When no Task trailer in PR body:
1. Check commit messages for Task: or Spec: trailers
2. Search recent tasks: kspec tasks list — match by title/description to PR scope
3. Check if changed files have // AC: @spec-ref annotations pointing to specs
4. If a spec is found, validate AC coverage identically to trailer-present case
5. Only skip AC validation if genuinely no spec exists for the changed behavior

## Principle
Reviewers should be investigators, not form-checkers. The absence of a trailer is a signal to look harder, not permission to skip validation.

inbox_items.text: Cross-feature requirement pattern: How to express that core features (search, validate, export) must support all entity types. When new entity type added, should automatically imply tasks for core features. Options: (1) applies_to field on feature specs, (2) trait on entity types like @trait-searchable, (3) validation warning for missing coverage, (4) parent spec that entity types must satisfy. Surfaced when realizing search doesn't cover inbox.

Reverse spec lookup - kspec which <file> or kspec which <file:line> to find specs/ACs that reference or are implemented by a given code path. Useful for bug fixes to quickly discover what specs need updating. Could scan for // AC: annotations and spec_ref links. Instructive, helps find already-instrumented code.

Add cross-platform CI matrix testing - run core functionality tests on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Would catch issues like Unix-specific commands (which, cp -r) before they reach PR review. Consider: matrix strategy in GitHub Actions, platform-specific test skips where needed, focus on CLI commands and daemon lifecycle.
E2E tests: Use isolated port range (not 3456) + cross-platform cleanup. Current approach conflicts with existing daemons. Should use high ephemeral port range and improve cleanup mechanism.
E2E test dev mode - configure Playwright to work with vite dev server instead of requiring full build for faster test iteration (12+ seconds to 1-2 seconds)

Improve derive granularity: Research suggests specs with 4+ ACs are candidates for splitting. Potential enhancements: (1) --by-ac flag to create tasks per AC group, (2) --max-acs N to auto-group, (3) implementation_phases field in specs, (4) derive templates for common patterns (cli-command, api-endpoint), (5) complexity warnings when specs are too large. See session research on task decomposition patterns from Linear, Atlassian, BDD/Example Mapping, and AI coding assistants.

Daemon debugging improvements: (1) Add --log-file or --verbose to 'kspec serve start', (2) Log resolved web UI path on startup, (3) Capture and show stderr when daemon fails to start within timeout. Consolidated from @01KFQ586, @01KFQ595, @01KFPH3D.

Project config file (kspec.config.yaml or .kspecrc): Configure shadow remote URL (enable separate repo for specs), feature toggles, default values (author, priority), validation strictness. Enables multi-repo projects sharing specs and tailoring kspec to project needs. Consolidated from @01KFGVVJ, @01KFGVVN.

AC test coverage analysis: 'kspec coverage @spec-ref' command to scan codebase for '// AC: @spec ac-N' annotations and report which ACs have test coverage vs gaps. Soft check for review, not blocking. Consolidated from @01KFHJNR, @01KFP9A6.

Shadow sync improvements: (1) Auto-resolve using rebase/merge-driver for cleaner sync, (2) Make sync warnings visible in CLI output (currently silent unless KSPEC_DEBUG=1), (3) Auto-detect common issues with suggested fixes. Consolidated from @01KFTDA7, @01KFHZR4.
